title: Scannex Training Programme
description: A staged Scannex training pathway for operators, using published e-book packages for LU 1 through LU 8 and placeholder module pages for the remaining learning units.
audience: Scannex operators, supervisors, and training coordinators who need stable Thinkific lesson URLs for testing and rollout.
integrationNotes: Use the clean URL-module links in Thinkific Multimedia lessons.
LU 1 through LU 8 are prepared as e-book packages for Thinkific testing.
Later Scannex learning units currently use placeholder pages until the published packages are promoted.
